}}'''Moilin daughter of [[Hamada]] daughter of [[Juendan]]''' was an [[Ogier]] [[author]] and [[historian]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Moilin|Moilin}}

==History==
Moilin wrote a book entitled ''[[A Study of the War of the Shadow]]''.{{ref||Moilin}} In the book, she described [[Be'lal]] as the "Netweaver." [[Loial]] quoted the book during a discussion of the [[Forsaken]] with [[Moiraine Damodred]].{{ref/book|3|50}}
